summary: rcf audit test-strength records a criterion whose bound tests all skip (node:test skip, the TAP # SKIP directive) per criterion as blocked, with a reason and detail naming the skipped test as <file>::<name>, judges the other criteria and writes the record under --record (exit 5 when none fails, 4 when one does); a criterion with some skipped and some run bound tests is judged on the ones that ran, the skipped ones named in its entry; a budget kill in the unmutated run exits 2 with one line naming the timeout, the budget in seconds, the --mutant-timeout flag, the test reached and that the budget covers all of a criterion's bound tests together, never 'fails under runner'; the help's --mutant-timeout text says the same. The exit codes AC-20502-5 states hold.
approach: src/audit/test-strength/report.js judge(): a pointer whose matched leaves all carry the skip directive reads as skipped, apart from notRun (no matching leaf). src/audit/test-strength/runner.js runMutants(): a skipped bound test neither kills nor ends the run, in the unmutated run and in each mutant run; a criterion all of whose bound tests skip is reported back as skipped with their pointers. src/audit/test-strength/index.js: a criterion all of whose bound tests skip becomes blocked after the unmutated run (result blocked, blocked true, mutants [], structural not counted, zero in every mutant count, a detail naming each skipped pointer), so the BLOCKED and FAIL lines and the record follow AC-19904-7; the skipped pointers of a judged criterion go in its entry; an unmutated result of timeout prints the timeout line in place of the 'fails under runner' line. src/cli/test-strength.js: the --mutant-timeout option text and the exit 2 list.
deliverables: src/audit/test-strength/report.js, runner.js and index.js: skipped bound tests and the timeout line (builder)
src/cli/test-strength.js: the --mutant-timeout option text and the exit-code list (builder)
